summary: Requires central account proof for automatic customer documentation domain admission.
userImpact: Verified-domain customer workspaces admit only centrally verified Cloud account sessions. Tenant-provider email assertions alone no longer authorize domain-based access. Individual-reader policies retain their immutable-account restrictions.

instructions: Install the corrected account service before enabling verified-domain customer documentation bundles.

configuration: No policy schema change. The publisher-selected verified_domain mode requires the persisted central cloud_account session class; explicit_readers remains unchanged.

changes: Existing workspace discovery and scoped session endpoints enforce the central account trust boundary. No response shape changes.

notes: Reuses the existing persisted source session class. No database migration.

security: A tenant-controlled identity provider cannot establish customer email-domain authority merely by asserting an allowed email or verified-email claim.
knownLimitations: Real corporate sign-in and deployed account/gateway isolation still require acceptance before customer content publication.
rollback: Disable verified-domain customer bundles before rolling back this fix.
validation: Local auth routes and domain-authority regressions: 16 files and 197 tests passed.
Exact account/gateway HTTP qualification with owned PostgreSQL: 2 files and 3 tests passed.
Backend/shared build, backend typecheck and affected lint passed. No deployed or customer-content publication acceptance is claimed.
